title: Actual scalar realizations of finite perfect adic coordinates
statement: With the marked finite quotient coordinates of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-marked-origin], every finite quotient coordinate has a family of actual scalar-realization isomorphisms on all pro-etale charts and restrictions. This is the realization component used by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence].

source.place: Tag 09C6, using the fixed-scalar realization and balancing of Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Pull each supplied coordinate comparison through the finite-scalar restriction functors on a pro-etale chart and then along a map to X. Exactness and the strict quotient representative identify the resulting object with the restricted completed quotient tower.

Transport the comparisons through the scalar slice equivalences and use the associated-module sheafification comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-coherence]. This supplies the displayed family of actual isomorphisms, including empty charts and zero coefficients.
